riskRegister.antiPlan: Do not pitch as venture-investible until identity, conversion, deliverability, official coverage, and legal/citation gates pass.

assumptions: Users will pay $5-$25 for civic letter workflow.
A $13 blended AOV can be achieved.
A $0.90 variable cost model is directionally plausible.
SEO can acquire demand after opt-in public pages exist.
One operator can manage launch exceptions.

contradictions: .planning/existing-state.md says zero application code exists, but current repo contains app code and tests.
.planning/ROADMAP.md says all phases complete, but .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md lists many pending launch items.
